summary: Orphan sources have zero local and cached highlights; missing local rows with positive API counts are not_synced.
reason: Incomplete highlight syncs must not recommend real sources as empty orphans.
markers: FROM books b LEFT JOIN highlights h ON h.book_id = b.id
reapply: Join books to local highlights on book_id, group by book id, and retain only COUNT(h.id)=0. Preserve NULL-safe cached num_highlights as metadata, expose highlights_local, and never include Reader documents as orphan sources. Restore seeded NULL/stale-count and limit regressions. Route positive cached counts with zero local highlights to not_synced_sources instead of orphan_sources, retaining uncapped totals and limits.
